data.name: Shady Brook - A Dark Mystery Text Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Relive the days of classic gaming with Shady Brook, a dark mystery text adventure inspired by the television series Twin Peaks in which players take on the role of author Jake Torrent in his search of a small town's twisted secrets.

Gameplay


Shady Brook combines the best elements of interactive fiction, visual novels, and gamebooks with a graphic user interface that emulates the look of early 1990s text adventures. It features beautiful artwork and cinematic music. In place of a text parser is a context-specific multiple choice menu. A compass allows you to travel from room to room, and separate inventory, map, journal, and character screens are available at the push of a button.

Shady Brook plays like an interactive novel. You make a series of choices that determine what happens next in the story. But unlike traditional gamebooks and choose-your-own adventures, Shady Brook also features more advanced adventure game mechanics, including locations to explore, items to collect and use, characters to meet and interact with, and puzzles to solve.

Story


Author Jake Torrent, alongside his blind father Wayne, moves to the small, peaceful country town of Shady Brook. At first, everything seems idyllic. His neighbor, Tim, is always willing to lend a hand, and the Ekan family invites him to dinner.

But soon, Jake learns that his home's previous occupant committed suicide, and mysterious things begin to occur. When another resident also commits suicide, Jake starts to suspect foul play. Could this town take part in a conspiracy to cover up a murder?

As Jake investigates, he gets more than he bargained for: a town secret so terrifying that there is no turning back...

Features

  • EXPLORE a small country town
  • INTERACT with nearly two dozen characters
  • CHOOSE your path--your actions alter the course of the story
  • PICK UP, COMBINE, and USE a multitude of inventory items
  • SOLVE a variety of challenging and unique puzzles
  • DISCOVER the town's terrifying secrets in a truly dark and mature storyline
  • ENJOY over 250 pieces of original artwork and an hour-long soundtrack
  • UNLOCK 33 achievements to view a special post-game bonus scene
  • PLAY 8+ hours of content with over 117,000 words--the text equivalent of a full-length novel!

data.short_description: Explore a small country town with a twisted secret in this dark, Twin Peaks-inspired mystery text adventure that combines the best elements of classic interactive fiction, visual novels, and gamebooks.

reviews.review:
A story driven text-based interactive adventure. The story starts with the main character Jake Torrent, an author who arrives in Shady Brook alongside his father who recently lost his wife. Deciding to take care of his blind father, Jake purchased a new house in a small country town- assuming it will be a quiet and peaceful one but the author's adventure starts the moment he set his foot in the new land as he discovered the man who previously been living in the house he purchased committed suicide. 

There are many characters in the games and many names you can't keep up with at first, but as you progress in the game you'll be more familiar with them. At first, I did not like the map of the game as there is no fast traveling to jump to the location you need, instead, you'll keep going back and forth all the time in order to reach the desired place, by that time you'll memorize the whole town.

The story started slow, but it built up into a very dark and creepy atmosphere with unexpected twists. It kept me on the edge of my seat as I'm reading and unfolding the secrets of the town. The ending made me speechless, it is a very well written story which worth a shot. The story length more than 8 hours, however, it took me 12 hours to finish it with full achievements. I had to use a guide though in some of the areas as the puzzles were quite challenging. Besides that, the main character was working on his newest novel named 'The sweater' I enjoyed reading it.. [spoiler]I wished he finished it[/spoiler]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1286124975

The artwork was OK, dated but fits the atmosphere of the game and interface, but I didn't like the wavy effect on some of them. I enjoyed the music, unfortunately, there is no choice to download them from the 'Extra' section, but they did a good job with the music. 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1286090658

Choices matters in this game, there are also timed choices which you have to choose quickly. I'm not sure if there are multiple endings depends on the choices, but there is a final score depends on your exploration.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1287890183

Pros:
+OK artwork didn't like the wavy effect on it though.
+Interesting dark and creepy story.
+Good music.
+Verywell-written story.
+OK map.
+Gamebook style.
+Detective them.
+Choices matters.
+Interesting characters.
+Points system.
+Good puzzles.
+Steam achievements.

Cons:
-No option for voice-overs.
-Lots of backtracking.
-Sometimes the objectives are not clear.

At the beginning of the game, you had the choice of censoring some of the dark themes in case you can't tolerate them. The game definitely not for everyone. I recommend the game to people who like to read and explore, this is not the kind of game you just click and skip for achievements.
